reviews.text: Great service and very competent vets and staff.
Best place to adopt a dog from. Maggie is a superstar!!
The staff were absolutely brilliant with our dog, was in and out in 40 mins,and got to the bottom of issue, highly recommend, thanks ladies  .
Waited 2hrs but there was a huge queue before me. Vet was amazing & looked after my lil doggy's itch.
They really care for your pet, prices are reasonable
Great staff and so caring about the animals that come into there care and Maggie still going and giving help to poorly animals,God Bless
